notes: Recalibrated 2026-10-31 (Build 415, rev 956dc070) from hardware captures: full Chromium headless on ANGLE Metal Apple M5, environment-lab ?terrain-look=1&site=ukraine, 1440x900, desktop tier, governor 0 (TERRAIN_LOOK_CHANNEL=chromium; shot.mjs default is SwiftShader). Corpus stills are tools/terrain-look/shots; the July set lives in shots/2026-07-29. The gate scores each still against the painted art-ref no-mans-land-mood-v1 (palette/structure distance, ground edge energy), not against the stills. Same-build noise: hardware a-vs-b byte-identical (0.000); SwiftShader-vs-M5 spread palette<=0.01, structure<=0.07, edge<=0.1. Thresholds = measured + 10x that noise (palette +0.10, structure +0.70, edge -1.0). Evidence: evidence/flight-look-2026-10-31. mode=fail: bin/look's terrain lane now obeys this field unless --mode is passed. Limits: governorLevel in provenance is a hard-coded 0 (the page does not report it); the painted ref is not the engine, so this catches drift from the 2026-10-31 look, not absolute quality; re-baseline deliberately when the look changes on purpose.
